name: omnicrawl
description: Local-first actor platform with a web dashboard, Chrome Browser Agent and Electron desktop runtime.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @omnicrawl/database build && pnpm --filter @omnicrawl/sdk build && pnpm --filter @omnicrawl/api build && pnpm --filter @omnicrawl/dashboard build
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @omnicrawl/database build && pnpm --filter @omnicrawl/sdk build && pnpm --parallel --filter @omnicrawl/api --filter @omnicrawl/dashboard dev
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @omnicrawl/desktop typecheck && pnpm --filter @omnicrawl/api test:proxy-security
